purpose: Teach: まんま/とび/破っ/お方/挟ま/うなずい/つかえ/ぶら

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お風呂上がりのまんまじゃ風邪ひくよ
lines.en: Sho, you'll catch a cold if you stay wet like that after your bath.
lines.style: Warm, practical concern with a maternal lilt. Soft urgency without alarm. Eyes checking him over. The tone of someone who notices what needs doing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、空のとびを見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a kite flying in the sky!
lines.style: Bright and breathless with excitement. Words tumble out quickly. Small-boy wonder in every syllable. The eagerness of someone sharing something he thinks is wonderful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達との約束を破っちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you mustn't break a promise you made to your friends.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Not scolding — teaching. A careful pause before the main clause. The tone of someone who knows he'll listen and wants to get it right.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんは優しいお方だね
lines.en: Mei-sis, you're such a kind person.
lines.style: Quiet observation, slightly wonder-struck. Said as if noticing something true for the first time. Soft, contemplative. The voice of a child understanding something about kindness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとぼくの真ん中に挟まれて寝てね
lines.en: Sho, sleep right here between Dad and me, okay?
lines.style: Tender and inviting. Warm as tucking in. A small smile in the voice. Reassurance that there's space for him, and it's a good place to be.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お話聞いてうなずいたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I listened to your story and nodded along the whole time.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his own attentiveness. Matter-of-fact but pleased. The small voice of someone reporting that he did something right and knows it matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おもちゃがつかえて取れないの?
lines.en: Sho, is your toy stuck? Can you not get it out?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry with a hint of problem-solving readiness. Slight tilt toward him. The voice checking in — not assuming, but offering help without pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、公園をぶらっとしてくる
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to wander around the park for a bit.
lines.style: Light, contented. A small boy's version of independence. Soft but clear. The tone of someone who feels safe enough to go and knows someone will be waiting.
